input.quote: enter into a new subordination agreement with a new lender(s) on terms and conditions that are taken as a whole not less favorable in any material respect to SFJ than those set forth in the subordination agreement to be entered into with SVB
input.rationale: Searches for MFN language (most favoured/favorable, no less favorable, better terms, comparable terms, match-the-offer, rights of first refusal) surface no MFN mechanic in the Agreement. The only "not less favorable ... to SFJ" language sits in Section 7.4 and concerns the terms of a replacement subordination agreement with a refinancing lender relative to the SVB subordination agreement — a lien-priority protection for SFJ as secured party, not an obligation on PB to extend SFJ any better commercial terms granted to third parties or to match third-party offers. PB therefore bears no MFN obligation, which meets the preferred position (no MFN burdening the Customer). No redline required.
